name: openreview
description: Area Chair workflow skills for the OpenReview MCP server (requires that server to be registered): venue setup from the conference's own guidelines, batch sync and dashboard, verbatim-quote per-paper dossiers with rebuttal tracking and fact-checks, reviewer messaging drafted by subagents and fact-checked (a send-gate hook blocks unverified or unapproved sends), and meta-review TL;DR plus refine.
